in_sanskrit.name: सतन्
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: That which is eternal, unchanging, or constant.

in_hindi.name: सतन
in_hindi.long_meaning: सत् (sat) means truth, existence, reality. तन् (tan) means that which exists. Therefore, Santan means 'eternal' or 'that which exists eternally'.

in_tamil.name: சந்தன்
in_tamil.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'satan' meaning 'eternal'. It can be translated as 'constant' or 'that which remains unchanged'.

in_telugu.name: సతన్న
in_telugu.long_meaning: This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'satan'. It means 'eternal' or 'that which exists eternally'.

in_marathi.name: Santan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे The eternal and endless one
in_marathi.long_meaning: Santan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Santan is derived from the Sanskrit word 'santana' which means 'that which is eternal, endless and continuous'. It is also used to describe the unending cycle of birth, death and rebirth.
